description: This file defines classes and enums for managing web chat UI components in a macOS app, including panel and window controllers, session management, and visibility handling.

classes.name: WebChatPanel
classes.description: A borderless NSPanel subclass that can still accept key focus, used for chat UI panels.

classes.name: WebChatPresentation
classes.description: An enum representing how the web chat is presented, either as a window or a panel with an anchor provider.

classes.name: WebChatManager
classes.description: A singleton managing chat sessions, windows, panels, and their visibility, with methods to show, toggle, close, and reset chat UI components.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays a chat session in a window, creating a new controller if needed.

methods.name: togglePanel
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the chat panel, creating or closing it as necessary.

methods.name: closePanel
methods.description: Closes the chat panel if it is open.

methods.name: preferredSessionKey
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the preferred session key, caching it for future use.

methods.name: resetTunnels
methods.description: Closes and clears all chat window and panel controllers and session keys.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Resets all tunnels and hides chat UI components.

methods.name: panelHidden
methods.description: Handles the event when the panel is hidden, updating visibility state.
